objectives: Hear /s/ followed immediately by /m/ at the beginning of taught words.
Blend /s/ and /m/ smoothly without inserting a vowel between them.
Distinguish the initial sm blend from /s/ alone and other taught blends.
Say the complete word after blending the onset with the remaining sounds.
concepts: The initial sm blend contains /s/ followed by /m/.
Both consonant sounds remain audible and in order.
No extra vowel belongs between /s/ and /m/.
Listening to the complete word confirms accurate blending.

definitions.definition: Two consonant sounds heard together at the beginning of a word.
A speech sound that can distinguish one word from another.
Joining speech sounds in order to say a word.

workedExamples.solution: Hear /s/ then /m/, followed by the rest of the word.
Smile begins with /s/ followed by /m/; sun begins with /s/ alone.
Keep /s/ and /m/ in order, then blend the rest of the word.
